description: R9-lite: smallest deliverable productization of the proven R2 evidence engine — a thin, explainable, reproducible, fail-closed CLI/library (odg-evidence-pack) composing the EXISTING supply-chain-attest engine into a client-deliverable pack (SBOM + SLSA-L1 provenance + licence-risk + report with explicit limits). No new primitive, no second orchestrator.

work_item_contract.objective: Turn demonstrated R2 evidence into an invokable, reproducible, deliverable pack product; prove it on synthetic + real public inputs; ship it as a dist bin.
work_item_contract.scope: Thin bin + library reusing supply-chain-attest; a focused test; add the bin to the dist compile list. NO new primitive/orchestrator; NO engine source change; NO network/secrets; readiness-not-certification.
invariants: Fail-closed: invalid lockfile throws (exit 1); empty ⇒ honest 0-component flagged pack (no false success); SBOM must reconcile.
Deliverable report states explicit LIMITS + liability EXCLUSIONS (evidence/readiness, NOT certification/compliance/SLSA-L2/security-guarantee).
No new permanent primitive; bin is a non-closure leaf (its dynamic require does not enter odg-run's closure).
Preserve uncommitted research docs + 5 stashes; do not commit research in this code commit.
acceptance_criteria: odg-evidence-pack.test.ts ALL PASS (reconcile, provenance verify, tamper-fail, reproducible, licence-risk, empty-negative, invalid-throws, pack files + report limits).
CLI runs on a real public lockfile (npm/cli v10.9.0) ⇒ OK, 1318 components, 5-file pack.
dist bin emitted + runs; tsc 0; supply-chain-attest regression + an equivalence-closure sanity PASS.
Final diff limited to the write-set; committed (no force).
stop_conditions: Any fix needs an engine source change or a path outside the write-set; a closure/equivalence regression.
work_item_contract.rollback: git checkout -- tsconfig.runtime-dist.json ODG_PROJECT_STATE.md; delete the bin + test + contract; rebuild dist from clean source.

objectives.goal: Ship the R9-lite evidence-pack product (reuse engine; fail-closed; dist bin).
done_when: Test ALL PASS; CLI proven on a real public lockfile; dist bin runs; regression+equivalence green; committed in write-set.

definition_of_done: odg-evidence-pack product shipped as a tested dist bin reusing the proven engine; fail-closed + explicit limits; proven on synthetic + real public inputs; committed (no force). It is a deliverable mechanism, NOT a client reference (R4) and NOT a certification.
